verses.sloka: ।। आदित्यहृदयप्रारम्भः ।।ततो युद्धपरिश्रन्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् ।रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ।। ६.१०७.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ।। ādityahṛdayaprārambhaḥ ।।tato yuddhapariśrantaṁ samare cintayā sthitam ।rāvaṇaṁ cāgrato dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya samupasthitam ।। 6.107.1 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.
translations.hindi: मह।दर और सद्दापाश्वे नामक दोनों राक्षसों को मरा हुआ देख, तथा महाबली वीर विरूपाक्ष को मरा हुआ देख

verses.sloka: दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम् ।उपागम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः ।। ६.१०७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: daivataiśca samāgamya draṣṭumabhyāgato raṇam ।upāgamyābravīdrāmamagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।। 6.107.2 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.
translations.hindi: उस महासमर में राण अत्यन्त कुपित हुआ | तदनन्तर उसने अपने सारथि को प्रेरणा करते हुए यह कहा

verses.sloka: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम् ।येन सर्वानरीन् वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसि ।। ६.१०७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṁ sanātanam ।yena sarvānarīn vatsa samare vijayiṣyasi ।। 6.107.3 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed Sri Rama! Dear, hear this eternal secret (mantra) which will enable you to win all the enemies in war."

verses.sloka: आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् ।जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम् ।। ६.१०७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādityahṛdayaṁ puṇyaṁ sarvaśatruvināśanam ।jayāvahaṁ japennityamakṣayyaṁ paramaṁ śivam ।। 6.107.4 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.
translations.hindi: में आज रामरूपी उस वृक्ष को काट गिराता हूँ जिसमें सीता- रूपी फल फला है और जिसके सुप्रीब, जाम्बवान्‌ , कुमु द, नल, १०८० युद्धकाण्डे मैन्द, विविद, अङ्गद, गन्धमादन, हनुमान्‌, एवं सुपेणादि समस्त वानर यूथपति डालियाँ और युद्दे हैं

verses.sloka: सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ।। ६.१०७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṁ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam ।। 6.107.5 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

verses.sloka: रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम् ।पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम् ।। ६.१०७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: raśmimantaṁ samudyantaṁ devāsuranamaskṛtam ।pūjayasva vivasvantaṁ bhāskaraṁ bhuvaneśvaram ।। 6.107.6 ।।

translations.english: "You worship the Sun God, crowned with rays rising up at the horizon, greeted by all gods and demons, who brings light to all and who is the embodiment of all gods."
translations.hindi: महारथी रावण रथ में सवार हो ओर रथ की घरघराहट से दसों दिशाओं को प्रतिध्वनित करता हुआ तथा गर्जेता हुआ, बड़ी शीघ्रता से श्ररामचन्द्र जी के सामने जा पहुँचा

verses.sloka: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः ।एष देवासुरगणान् लोकान् पाति गभिस्तिभिः ।। ६.१०७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvadevātmako hyeṣa tejasvī raśmibhāvanaḥ ।eṣa devāsuragaṇān lokān pāti gabhistibhiḥ ।। 6.107.7 ।।

translations.english: "He is the self in all, glorious, he sustains by his rays of light, the gods, suras and the whole world. He is the Lord of all.

verses.sloka: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः ।महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपां पतिः ।। ६.१०७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaḥ skandaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।mahendro dhanadaḥ kālo yamaḥ somo hyapāṁ patiḥ ।। 6.107.8 ।।

translations.english: "In the same way, he is the body of Brahma the creator, he is Vishnu also, Shiva also, S Kanda, Prajapati, Mahendra, Kubera, time spirit, Yama, Soma, and Varuna also.
translations.hindi: उसके सिंहनाद के शब्द से नदियों, पहाड़ों और बलों एवं बहाँ के शूकरों, सगो ओर हाथियों सहित प्रथिवी, प्रतिध्वनित हो, काँप उठी ॥७७ तामसं स महाघोरे चकारास्नं सुदारुणम्‌ । निर्देदाह कपीन्‌ सबोस्ते प्रपेतुः समन्ततः

verses.sloka: पितरो वसवः साध्या ह्यश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः ।वायुर्वह्निः प्रजापाण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः ।। ६.१०७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hyaśvinau maruto manuḥ ।vāyurvahniḥ prajāpāṇa ṛtukartā prabhākaraḥ ।। 6.107.9 ।।

translations.english: "He is the god of manes, Vasava, Sadhayas, Aswins, Marutha, Manu, wind god, fire god, life of all beings and god of all seasons.

verses.sloka: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान् ।सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः ।। ६.१०७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: ādityaḥ savitā sūryaḥ khagaḥ pūṣā gabhastimān ।suvarṇasadṛśo bhānurhiraṇyaretā divākaraḥ ।। 6.107.10 ।।

translations.english: "You are the son of Aditi, the sungod, creator Savitha, the courser in the heavens, the sustainer, the possessor of golden rays, Bhanu, shining with golden rays, the Sun god.

verses.sloka: हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिर्मरीचिमान् ।तिमिरोन्मथनः शम्भुस्त्वष्टा मार्तण्ड अंशुमान् ।। ६.१०७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: haridaśvaḥ sahasrārciḥ saptasaptirmarīcimān ।timironmathanaḥ śambhustvaṣṭā mārtaṇḍa aṁśumān ।। 6.107.11 ।।

translations.english: "You are the possessor of seven green horses, having a thousand rays, having horse Sapta, destroyer of darkness, mitigator of the suffering of all devotees, giver of happiness, destroyer of all names and forms, the infuser of life in the cosmic egg and having the allpervading rays.
translations.hindi: तब राक्षसश्रेष्ठ रावण ने, कपिसेना को भगा कर, देखा कि, किसी से कभी परास्त न होने बाले, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी उससे लड़ने के लिए तेयार खड़े हैं

verses.sloka: हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनो भास्करो रविः ।अग्निगर्भो ऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः ।। ६.१०७.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śiśirastapano bhāskaro raviḥ ।agnigarbho 'diteḥ putraḥ śaṅkhaḥ śiśiranāśanaḥ ।। 6.107.12 ।।

translations.english: "You have the golden cosmic egg in the womb, you are cool, you are the purifier, the ruler of all, bringer of day, who Bears the fire of dissolution in the womb. You are the son of Aditi, blissful personified and destroyer of cold.
translations.hindi: इनके पास उनके भाई लक्ष्मण बैसे ही खड़ द, जैसे विष्चु के साथ इन्द्र । ( उस समय ) वे अपने ।<राल घलुष को उठाए सानो आकाश को स्पर्श कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी ऋग्यजुस्सामपारगः ।घनवृष्टिरपां मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः ।। ६.१०७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vyomanāthastamobhedī ṛgyajussāmapāragaḥ ।ghanavṛṣṭirapāṁ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṅgamaḥ ।। 6.107.13 ।।

translations.english: "You are the Lord of the sky, dispeller of darkness, the master of the three VedasRig, Yajur and Sama, the sender of rain, the friend of water and the courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly.
translations.hindi: रावण ने कमलदल समान विशालनयन, जाँघों तक लटकता हुई लंबी सुजा वाले और शत्रुसूदन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को देखा। तदनन्वर लक्ष्मण सहित महाबलबान और महातेजस्वी श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी ने

verses.sloka: आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः ।कविर्विश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः ।। ६.१०७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ātapī maṇḍalī mṛtyuḥ piṅgalaḥ sarvatāpanaḥ ।kavirviśvo mahātejā raktaḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ ।। 6.107.14 ।।

translations.english: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे वानरांश्च रणे भग्नानापतन्त च रावणम्‌ । समीक्ष्य राघवो हृष्टो मध्ये जग्राह कामुकम्‌ ॥॥१४! बानरों को रण में घायल हो. भागते अर रावण को आते देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने हर्षित हो धनुष को बीच में पकड़ा

verses.sloka: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः ।तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन्नमो ऽस्तु ते ।। ६.१०७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmadhipo viśvabhāvanaḥ ।tejasāmapi tejasvī dvādaśātmannamo 'stu te ।। 6.107.15 ।।

translations.english: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.

verses.sloka: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमे गिरये नमः ।ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः ।। ६.१०७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścime giraye namaḥ ।jyotirgaṇānāṁ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ ।। 6.107.16 ।।

translations.english: "Hail to you, rising on the east mountain, setting in the west. Hail to the Lord of all luminaries.

verses.sloka: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः ।नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः ।। ६.१०७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: jayāya jayabhadrāya haryaśvāya namo namaḥ ।namo namaḥ sahasrāṁśo ādityāya namo namaḥ ।। 6.107.17 ।।

translations.english: "Namaskar, Namaskar to the giver of victory, joy born of victory, god having green horses. Hail to you Aditya.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों राजकुमारों के बाणों के लक्ष्य के भीतर स्थित सवश ऐसा शोभित हुआ, मानों चन्द्रमा आर सूये के समीपस्थित राहु शोभित हो रहा हो

verses.sloka: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः ।नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ।। ६.१०७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: nama ugrāya vīrāya sāraṅgāya namo namaḥ ।namaḥ padmaprabodhāya mārtāṇḍāya namo namaḥ ।। 6.107.18 ।।

translations.english: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मोशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे ।भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः ।। ६.१०७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: brahmośānācyuteśāya sūryāyādityavarcase ।bhāsvate sarvabhakṣāya raudrāya vapuṣe namaḥ ।। 6.107.19 ।।

translations.english: "Namskar to you, the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, to you the Sun god, the spiritual dwelling light in solar orbit, the consumer of all appearing in the form of Rudra.

verses.sloka: तमोघ्नाय हिमध्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने ।कृतघ्नघ्नाय देवाय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः ।। ६.१०७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tamoghnāya himadhnāya śatrughnāyāmitātmane ।kṛtaghnaghnāya devāya jyotiṣāṁ pataye namaḥ ।। 6.107.20 ।।

translations.english: "You are the dispeller of darkness, dispeller of cold, dispeller of enemies, your extent is immeasurable. You are the destroyer of the ungrateful, the ruler of lights, the Lord of all and namaskar to you.
translations.hindi: ठ अपने हाथ का सफाइ दिखल्लाते हुए रावण ने, लक्ष्मण के चलाए एक बाण को एक बाण से, तीन बाणों को तीन बाणों से आर दस बार्णो को दस बाणों से काट गिराया

verses.sloka: तप्तचामीकराभाय वह्नये विश्वकर्मणे ।नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे ।। ६.१०७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: taptacāmīkarābhāya vahnaye viśvakarmaṇe ।namastamobhinighnāya rucaye lokasākṣiṇe ।। 6.107.21 ।।

translations.english: "Namaskar to one possessing the lustre of pure gold, dispeller of darkness, architect of the universe, splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, witnessor of all actions in the world.
translations.hindi: अभ्यतिक्रम्य सौमित्रिं रावणः समितिञ्जयः । आससाद ततो रामं स्थितं गैलमिवाचलम्‌ ॥२१ फिरि समरविजयो रावण, लदमण के साथ युद्ध करना छोड़ पवत की तरह अटल अचल खड़े हुए, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सामने गया

verses.sloka: नाशयत्येष वै भूतं तदेव सृजति प्रभुः ।पायत्येष तपत्येष वर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः ।। ६.१०७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṁ tadeva sṛjati prabhuḥ ।pāyatyeṣa tapatyeṣa varṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ ।। 6.107.22 ।।

translations.english: "Being a creator and destroyer of the world, this Sun god alone radiates, creates thirst by heat and rains to relieve.
translations.hindi: युद्ध सें श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को पा कर, रावण के नेन्न मारे क्रोध के लाल हो गए और बह श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर बाणुदृष्टि करने लगा

verses.sloka: एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः ।एष एवाग्निहोत्रं च फलं चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम् ।। ६.१०७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ ।eṣa evāgnihotraṁ ca phalaṁ caivāgnihotriṇām ।। 6.107.23 ।।

translations.english: "He alone pervades the created beings and remains awake in sleep. He alone is the fire sacrifice as well as the fruits obtained from fire sacrifice.
translations.hindi: र १०८४ युद्धकाण्डे राबण के घुष से होती हुईं बाणबृष्टि को अपने ऊपर बडा शीघ्रता से आते देख, श्रोराम चन्द्र जी ने बड़ी फुर्ती से भल्लाकार बार निकाले

verses.sloka: वेदाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च ।यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ।। ६.१०७.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vedāśca kratavaścaiva kratūnāṁ phalameva ca ।yāni kṛtyāni lokeṣu sarva eṣa raviḥ prabhuḥ ।। 6.107.24 ।।

translations.english: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.

verses.sloka: एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च ।कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव ।। ६.१०७.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: enamāpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca ।kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścinnāvasīdati rāghava ।। 6.107.25 ।।

translations.english: "O Raghava! Anyone praying to him will surely not experience grief in straits, in difficulties, in the woods and in times of fear.

verses.sloka: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम् ।एतत्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यसि ।। ६.१०७.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūjayasvainamekāgro devadevaṁ jagatpatim ।etatriguṇitaṁ japtvā yuddheṣu vijayiṣyasi ।। 6.107.26 ।।

translations.english: "Worship the Lord of the universe, the Lord of Lords. Worship him alone with concentration of mind, three times of the day by chanting his name. You will attain victory in war."
translations.hindi: एक दूसरे पर बड़े वेग से बाणों को छोड्ते हुए तथा किसी से | हुए, चित्र. कोई न हारता हुआ, वे दोनों दाये बांये पैतरे बदलते पिचित्र कावे काट रहे थे

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि ।एवमुक्त्वा तदा ऽगस्त्यो जगाम च यथागतम् ।। ६.१०७.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṁ tvaṁ vadhiṣyasi ।evamuktvā tadā 'gastyo jagāma ca yathāgatam ।। 6.107.27 ।।

translations.english: Agastya having spoken in that way to the mighty armed Rama to worship the Sun God and assuring him that the very moment he will be able to kill Ravana, left in the same way.

verses.sloka: एतच्छुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोको ऽभवत्तदा ।धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ।। ६.१०७.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: etacchutvā mahātejā naṣṭaśoko 'bhavattadā ।dhārayāmāsa suprīto rāghavaḥ prayatātmavān ।। 6.107.28 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama endowed with extra ordinary energy having heard Agastya, was very delighted and stopped worry. He remembered Aditya and chanted in his mind.
translations.hindi: उस सपय वर्षा ऋतु में ब्रिजली सहित मेघों की तरह, इन दोनों बोरा के चचाए हुए विविध प्रकार के बाणों से आकांश- [डल ढक गया

verses.sloka: आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वा तु परं हर्षमवाप्तवान् ।त्रिराचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।। ६.१०७.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādityaṁ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṁ harṣamavāptavān ।trirācamya śucirbhūtvā dhanurādāya vīryavān ।। 6.107.29 ।।

translations.english: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.

verses.sloka: रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धाय समुपागमत् ।सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतो ऽभवत् ।। ६.१०७.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā yuddhāya samupāgamat ।sarvayatnena mahatā vadhe tasya dhṛto 'bhavat ।। 6.107.30 ।।

translations.english: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.

verses.sloka: अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य रामं मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः ।निशिचरपतिसङ्क्षयं विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति ।। ६.१०७.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha raviravadannirīkṣya rāmaṁ muditamanāḥ paramaṁ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ ।niśicarapatisaṅkṣayaṁ viditvā suragaṇamadhyagato vacastvareti ।। 6.107.31 ।।

translations.english: Then the sun, glad at heart and exceedingly rejoicing, standing amid the hosts of gods, learnt of the destruction of the lord of night-rangers, gazed upon Rama and spoke the word: "Make haste."

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 107 ।।
